audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty framing hangs on 'blind his Riftwalk', which is not a thing — Riftwalk is a blink and Kassadin's damage is magic abilities, so Blinding Assault's nearsight barely touches him.
audit.why: Quinn Q hinders vision / blinds basic attacks; Kassadin's threat is Null Sphere and Riftwalk, plus one Nether Blade auto.
audit.corrected: Reframed: the lane is favoured because he is a melee with no escape before 6, not because of the blind. diff FAV and 4/10 remain correct at 53.29% over 304 games.

audit.why: Both layers read Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin — matching the packet chart and the already-audited mirror exactly, and the whys[] captions agree.
audit.corrected: No chart edits needed. Spike ladder (lvl 1-2 Harrier autos, lvl 2-3 Vault pattern, lvl 6 Riftwalk, 2+ items Rod of Ages) is accurate and left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability facts are fabricated: 'Q silence locks out your E disengage' (Null Sphere is not a silence) and the blind being relevant. The real interaction — Null Sphere interrupts channels, i.e. Behind Enemy Lines — is never stated. Nether Blade's auto-attack reset is also absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: Null Sphere deals damage 'interrupting channels' and shields magic damage only. The kit file's 'channel: interruptible' flag on Null Sphere is a tooltip-parse misfire pointing the wrong direction, as the mirror also recorded. Quinn's R is a channel. Nether Blade is flagged autoReset.
audit.corrected: whys[6], wants.foe[2], late, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now say Null Sphere interrupts the Behind Enemy Lines take-off and shields magic only; dosFull[2] now teaches the Nether Blade wind-up as the step-back cue.

audit.why: Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s, Force Pulse 21s at rank 1, Nether Blade 7s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

edits.before: Bully him early — blind his Riftwalk and kite the all-in apart. Quinn wins the Riftwalk cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bully him early — he is melee with no escape until 6. Kill him before Riftwalk's blink arrives at level 6.

edits.before: Blind his Riftwalk and kite the all-in apart. Track Riftwalk before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny him levels before 6 — Null Sphere shields magic only, so your autos land clean. Starve the wave, punish walk-ups.

edits.before: Kassadin wastes Riftwalk — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His combo opens with a W auto reset — step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Track Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1 down to 2s, so post-6 he blinks out of Vault range. Null Sphere interrupts Behind Enemy Lines.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1 falling to 2s — his mobility spike at 6, so kill him before it scales. - Force Pulse: 21s and only usable once spells charge it. - Behind Enemy Lines: Null Sphere interrupts the take-off.

edits.before: Full-build Kassadin Q-silences your E and R-blinks onto you — you are squishy and lose the late outright, so end before this.
edits.after: Full-build Kassadin interrupts your R with Null Sphere and blinks onto you — squishy, you lose the late outright, so end early.

edits.before: Use his Q silence to lock out your E disengage, then R-blink onto you post-6
edits.after: Interrupt your Behind Enemy Lines with Null Sphere, then R-blink onto you post-6

edits.before: This is his game if you let it get here. Once Rod of Ages and Rylai's come online he out-bursts you, his Q silence locks out your E disengage, and his R lets him blink-kite you down faster than you can run — you are squishy with no front-to-back answer. Your only path is to have already snowballed: ended the game, taken his tower, or fed your carries off R roams before ~20 minutes. If it goes late and even, you lose.
edits.after: This is his game if you let it get here. Once Rod of Ages and Rylai's come online he out-bursts you, Null Sphere interrupts your Behind Enemy Lines take-off, and his 2s R blink-kites you down faster than you can run — you are squishy with no front-to-back answer. Your only path is to have already snowballed: ended the game, taken his tower, or fed your carries off R roams before ~20 minutes. If it goes late and even, you lose.

notes: champ-data/_kits/_kits/kassadin.json flags Null Sphere with channel: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Riot's own description says the opposite — Null Sphere interrupts channels.
